note: Thai loop. Thai tokenizes into fragments rather than one token, because vowel and tone marks are \p{M} and split the \p{L} runs -- so word mode happens to score high here. That is shredding, not tokenization, and it is not something to rely on. Char mode scores it properly at 0.922.
